label: A landing page
html:
<style>
  @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@400;500;700;800&display=swap');
  /* A product launch: light moving far behind the hero, the promise's last words in a gradient, a speech bubble
     that answers the first question, and the three things the product makes unnecessary - struck through. Looks:
     Daybreak (follows light / dark), Midnight (aurora behind the hero) and Sunbeam (yellow and black, hard edges). */
  #top {
    --background: oklch(0.985 0.005 255);
    --foreground: oklch(0.22 0.035 265);
    --card: oklch(1 0 0);
    --card-foreground: var(--foreground);
    --muted: oklch(0.955 0.01 255);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.5 0.03 265);
    --border: oklch(0.9 0.015 255);
    --input: var(--border);
    --primary: oklch(0.5 0.2 265);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.99 0.005 255);
    --secondary: oklch(0.95 0.025 255);
    --secondary-foreground: var(--foreground);
    /* --accent is what the components hover with (the menu, the selects): a soft tint, never the brand's second colour */
    --accent: oklch(0.945 0.025 265);
    --accent-foreground: oklch(0.3 0.12 265);
    --popover: oklch(1 0 0);
    --popover-foreground: var(--foreground);
    --ring: var(--primary);
    --chart-1: oklch(0.5 0.2 265);
    --chart-2: oklch(0.72 0.16 30);
    --radius: 0.75rem;
    --radius-sm: max(0px, calc(var(--radius) - 4px));
    --radius-md: max(0px, calc(var(--radius) - 2px));
    --radius-lg: var(--radius);
    --radius-xl: calc(var(--radius) + 4px);
    --lp-from: oklch(0.5 0.2 265);
    --lp-to: oklch(0.7 0.17 25);
    --lp-bubble: oklch(0.94 0.1 100);
    --lp-bubble-ink: oklch(0.22 0.035 265);
    --lp-strike: oklch(0.6 0.2 25);
    color-scheme: light;
    overflow-x: clip;
    background: var(--background);
    color: var(--foreground);
    font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', var(--font-sans);
  }
  .dark #top[data-look='daybreak'] {
    color-scheme: dark;
    --background: oklch(0.19 0.03 265);
    --foreground: oklch(0.95 0.01 255);
    --card: oklch(0.23 0.035 265);
    --muted: oklch(0.26 0.035 265);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.76 0.03 260);
    --border: oklch(0.34 0.04 265);
    --primary: oklch(0.74 0.14 265);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.19 0.03 265);
    --secondary: oklch(0.29 0.045 265);
    --accent: oklch(0.3 0.055 265);
    --accent-foreground: oklch(0.95 0.02 265);
    --popover: oklch(0.23 0.035 265);
    --popover-foreground: oklch(0.95 0.01 255);
    --lp-from: oklch(0.76 0.13 265);
    --lp-to: oklch(0.8 0.13 30);
    --lp-bubble: oklch(0.85 0.13 100);
  }
  #top[data-look='midnight'] {
    color-scheme: dark;
    --background: oklch(0.15 0.03 250);
    --foreground: oklch(0.96 0.012 200);
    --card: oklch(0.19 0.035 250);
    --muted: oklch(0.22 0.04 250);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.77 0.03 210);
    --border: oklch(0.32 0.045 250);
    --primary: oklch(0.86 0.14 170);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.15 0.03 250);
    --secondary: oklch(0.25 0.045 250);
    --secondary-foreground: var(--foreground);
    --accent: oklch(0.27 0.05 250);
    --accent-foreground: oklch(0.96 0.012 200);
    --popover: oklch(0.19 0.035 250);
    --popover-foreground: oklch(0.96 0.012 200);
    --chart-1: oklch(0.86 0.14 170);
    --chart-2: oklch(0.75 0.15 300);
    --lp-from: oklch(0.86 0.14 170);
    --lp-to: oklch(0.78 0.15 300);
    --lp-bubble: oklch(0.86 0.14 170);
    --lp-bubble-ink: oklch(0.15 0.03 250);
    --lp-strike: oklch(0.78 0.15 300);
  }
  #top[data-look='sunbeam'] {
    color-scheme: light;
    --background: oklch(0.975 0.016 85);
    --foreground: oklch(0.17 0.01 70);
    --card: oklch(0.995 0.006 85);
    --muted: oklch(0.945 0.03 85);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.4 0.03 70);
    --border: oklch(0.17 0.01 70);
    --primary: oklch(0.17 0.01 70);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.975 0.016 85);
    --secondary: oklch(0.995 0.006 85);
    --secondary-foreground: oklch(0.17 0.01 70);
    --accent: oklch(0.93 0.06 85);
    --accent-foreground: oklch(0.17 0.01 70);
    --popover: oklch(0.995 0.006 85);
    --popover-foreground: oklch(0.17 0.01 70);
    --chart-1: oklch(0.72 0.17 60);
    --chart-2: oklch(0.17 0.01 70);
    --radius: 0.25rem;
    --lp-from: oklch(0.17 0.01 70);
    --lp-to: oklch(0.62 0.17 50);
    --lp-bubble: oklch(0.995 0.006 85);
    --lp-strike: oklch(0.62 0.17 50);
  }
  #top .lp-look-only {
    display: none;
  }
  #top[data-look='daybreak'] .lp-look-only[data-for='daybreak'],
  #top[data-look='midnight'] .lp-look-only[data-for='midnight'],
  #top[data-look='sunbeam'] .lp-look-only[data-for='sunbeam'] {
    display: block;
  }
  #top .lp-light {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    mask-image: radial-gradient(60% 70% at 50% 40%, #000 20%, transparent 75%);
    opacity: 0.7;
  }
  #top .lp-rays {
    --surface-size: 40px;
    --surface-ink: oklch(0.15 0 0 / 0.08);
    mask-image: radial-gradient(60% 70% at 50% 40%, #000, transparent 75%);
  }
  #top .mk-hero-title {
    font-weight: 800;
    letter-spacing: -0.04em;
  }
  #top .lp-grad {
    background: linear-gradient(95deg, var(--lp-from), var(--lp-to));
    -webkit-background-clip: text;
    background-clip: text;
    color: transparent;
  }
  #top[data-look='sunbeam'] .lp-grad {
    background: none;
    color: var(--lp-to);
    text-decoration: underline 0.12em;
    text-underline-offset: 0.08em;
  }
  /* the answer to the first question, in a speech bubble */
  #top .mk-hero-copy {
    position: relative;
  }
  #top .lp-bubble {
    position: absolute;
    top: -3.25rem;
    right: max(-2rem, -4vw);
    max-width: 13rem;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0.8rem 1rem;
    border: 2px solid var(--foreground);
    border-radius: 1rem;
    background: var(--lp-bubble);
    color: var(--lp-bubble-ink);
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    line-height: 1.25;
    rotate: 6deg;
    box-shadow: 0.3rem 0.3rem 0 var(--foreground);
    animation: lp-float 5s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  #top .lp-bubble::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    left: 1.5rem;
    bottom: -0.85rem;
    width: 1.2rem;
    height: 0.85rem;
    background: var(--foreground);
    clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 0 100%);
  }
  @keyframes lp-float {
    50% {
      translate: 0 -0.35rem;
      rotate: 4deg;
    }
  }
  @media (max-width: 52rem) {
    #top .lp-bubble {
      position: static;
      margin-block-end: 1rem;
      rotate: -2deg;
    }
  }
  /* what you will not need any more */
  #top .lp-gone {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 0.5rem 1.25rem;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    list-style: none;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  #top .lp-gone li {
    position: relative;
  }
  #top .lp-gone li::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    left: -0.2em;
    right: -0.2em;
    top: 52%;
    height: 0.14em;
    border-radius: 1em;
    background: var(--lp-strike);
    rotate: -4deg;
    transform-origin: left center;
    animation: lp-strike 900ms ease-out both;
  }
  #top .lp-gone li:nth-child(2)::after {
    animation-delay: 300ms;
    rotate: 3deg;
  }
  #top .lp-gone li:nth-child(3)::after {
    animation-delay: 600ms;
  }
  @keyframes lp-strike {
    from {
      scale: 0 1;
    }
  }
  #top[data-look='sunbeam'] :is(.mk-feature, .mk-pricing-card, .frame-window) {
    border: 2px solid var(--foreground) !important;
    box-shadow: 0.4rem 0.4rem 0 var(--foreground);
  }
  #top[data-look='sunbeam'] .mk-feature {
    padding: clamp(1.25rem, 2.5vw, 2rem);
    background: var(--card);
  }
  /* the block's rule under the row and between the columns would cross the frames */
  #top[data-look='sunbeam'] .mk-features-grid {
    gap: 1.5rem;
    border-bottom: 0;
  }
  @container mk-features (min-width: 30rem) {
    #top[data-look='sunbeam'] .mk-features-grid {
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    }
  }
  #top[data-look='sunbeam'] .mk-feature-sep {
    display: none;
  }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    #top .lp-bubble {
      animation: none;
    }
    #top .lp-gone li::after {
      animation: none;
    }
  }
  /* the page's rhythm: every section on a band of its own, the quiet ones tinted; no empty gaps between them */
  #top {
    --lp-band: oklch(0.962 0.014 262);
    --lp-cta: var(--primary);
    --lp-cta-ink: var(--primary-foreground);
  }
  .dark #top[data-look='daybreak'] {
    --lp-band: oklch(0.215 0.034 265);
  }
  #top[data-look='midnight'] {
    --lp-band: oklch(0.18 0.034 250);
  }
  #top[data-look='sunbeam'] {
    --lp-band: oklch(0.95 0.035 82);
    --lp-cta: oklch(0.17 0.01 70);
    --lp-cta-ink: oklch(0.975 0.016 85);
  }
  #top > :not(:first-child) {
    padding-block: clamp(4.5rem, 9vw, 7rem);
  }
  #top .lp-band {
    --muted: var(--card);
    background: var(--lp-band);
  }
  #top[data-look='sunbeam'] .lp-band {
    border-block: 2px solid var(--foreground);
  }
  /* a phone: the look and the language keep their place, the menu holds the rest */
  @media (max-width: 30rem) {
    #top .mk-header-inner {
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      row-gap: 0.5rem;
    }
  }
  #top .mk-header-nav :is(a, button) {
    font-size: 0.9375rem;
  }
  /* the hero's answer: a card-coloured bubble, tilted a little */
  #top .lp-bubble {
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    background: var(--card);
    color: var(--foreground);
    box-shadow: 0 18px 40px -18px color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 45%, transparent);
    rotate: 4deg;
  }
  #top .lp-bubble::after {
    left: 1.5rem;
    bottom: -0.45rem;
    width: 0.8rem;
    height: 0.8rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-width: 0 1px 1px 0;
    background: var(--card);
    clip-path: none;
    rotate: 45deg;
  }
  #top[data-look='sunbeam'] .lp-bubble {
    border: 2px solid var(--foreground);
    box-shadow: 0.3rem 0.3rem 0 var(--foreground);
  }
  #top[data-look='sunbeam'] .lp-bubble::after {
    border-width: 0 2px 2px 0;
    border-color: var(--foreground);
  }
  /* "Want to know more?" - the one loud band before the end: the brand colour, the team's faces, one big button */
  #top .mk-contact {
    box-sizing: border-box;
    max-width: 72rem;
    gap: 1.75rem;
    padding: clamp(3rem, 7vw, 5rem) clamp(1.5rem, 5vw, 4rem);
    border: 0;
    border-radius: calc(var(--radius) * 2);
    background:
      radial-gradient(90% 120% at 100% 0%, color-mix(in oklch, var(--lp-to) 55%, transparent), transparent 60%),
      radial-gradient(70% 90% at 0% 100%, color-mix(in oklch, var(--lp-from) 70%, black 10%), transparent 70%),
      var(--lp-cta);
    color: var(--lp-cta-ink);
    text-align: center;
    box-shadow: 0 40px 80px -40px color-mix(in oklch, var(--lp-cta) 70%, transparent);
  }
  #top .mk-contact-title {
    margin: 0;
    color: inherit;
    font-size: clamp(2rem, 4.5vw, 3.25rem);
    font-weight: 800;
    letter-spacing: -0.035em;
    line-height: 1.05;
  }
  #top .mk-contact-desc {
    margin: 0.75rem 0 0;
    color: color-mix(in oklch, currentColor 82%, transparent);
    font-size: 1.125rem;
  }
  #top .mk-contact-avatars .avatar {
    --avatar-size: 3rem;
    width: 3rem;
    height: 3rem;
    outline: 3px solid var(--lp-cta);
    filter: none;
  }
  #top .mk-contact-cta {
    height: 3rem;
    padding-inline: 1.75rem;
    border: 0;
    background: var(--lp-cta-ink);
    color: var(--lp-cta);
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: 700;
  }
  #top[data-look='sunbeam'] .mk-contact {
    background: var(--lp-cta);
  }
  /* the end band: the newsletter as a card over a dark footer */
  #top .lp-end {
    color-scheme: dark;
    --background: oklch(0.17 0.035 266);
    --foreground: oklch(0.96 0.01 255);
    --card: oklch(0.215 0.04 266);
    --card-foreground: var(--foreground);
    --muted: oklch(0.24 0.04 266);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.76 0.03 260);
    --border: oklch(1 0 0 / 0.11);
    --input: oklch(1 0 0 / 0.18);
    --primary: oklch(0.74 0.14 265);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.17 0.035 266);
    --secondary: oklch(0.26 0.04 266);
    --secondary-foreground: var(--foreground);
    --accent: oklch(0.26 0.04 266);
    --accent-foreground: var(--foreground);
    padding-block: clamp(4rem, 8vw, 6rem) 0;
    background: var(--background);
    color: var(--foreground);
  }
  #top[data-look='midnight'] .lp-end {
    --background: oklch(0.11 0.03 250);
    --card: oklch(0.16 0.035 250);
    --muted: oklch(0.19 0.035 250);
    --primary: oklch(0.86 0.14 170);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.13 0.03 250);
  }
  #top[data-look='sunbeam'] .lp-end {
    --background: oklch(0.17 0.01 70);
    --foreground: oklch(0.96 0.02 85);
    --card: oklch(0.22 0.012 70);
    --muted: oklch(0.25 0.012 70);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.82 0.04 85);
    --border: oklch(0.96 0.02 85 / 0.16);
    --primary: oklch(0.8 0.15 75);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.17 0.01 70);
    --accent: oklch(0.27 0.015 70);
    --accent-foreground: oklch(0.96 0.02 85);
  }
  #top .lp-end > .parallax-reveal {
    padding: 0 1.25rem clamp(3.5rem, 7vw, 5rem);
  }
  #top .mk-newsletter {
    box-sizing: border-box;
    max-width: 72rem;
    margin-inline: auto;
    padding: clamp(2rem, 4.5vw, 3.25rem);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: calc(var(--radius) * 1.5);
    background:
      radial-gradient(80% 140% at 100% 0%, color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 26%, transparent), transparent 65%),
      var(--card);
  }
  #top .mk-newsletter-layout {
    align-items: center;
    gap: 2rem 3rem;
  }
  #top .mk-newsletter-title {
    font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 3.2vw, 2.375rem);
    font-weight: 800;
    letter-spacing: -0.03em;
    line-height: 1.1;
  }
  #top .mk-newsletter-desc {
    margin-block-start: 0.625rem;
    max-width: 30rem;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 1.0625rem;
    line-height: 1.55;
  }
  #top .mk-newsletter-form {
    gap: 0.5rem;
  }
  #top .mk-newsletter-form :is(.input, .btn) {
    height: 3rem;
    font-size: 1rem;
  }
  #top .mk-newsletter-form .input {
    background: oklch(0 0 0 / 0.2);
  }
  #top .mk-newsletter-form .btn {
    padding-inline: 1.25rem;
    font-weight: 700;
  }
  #top .mk-newsletter-note {
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
  }
  #top .mk-footer {
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--foreground);
  }
  #top .mk-footer-inner {
    max-width: 72rem;
    padding-block: 0 2.5rem;
  }
  #top .mk-footer-heading {
    color: var(--foreground);
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  #top .mk-footer-list a {
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.9375rem;
  }
  #top .mk-footer-list a:hover {
    color: var(--foreground);
  }
  #top .mk-footer-brand {
    color: var(--foreground);
  }
  /* the footer signs off with the name, set big and fading into the band */
  #top .lp-wordmark {
    margin: 0;
    padding-inline: 1.25rem;
    overflow: hidden;
    font-size: clamp(5rem, 21vw, 19rem);
    font-weight: 800;
    line-height: 0.78;
    letter-spacing: -0.06em;
    text-align: center;
    color: transparent;
    background: linear-gradient(to bottom, color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 16%, transparent), transparent 85%);
    -webkit-background-clip: text;
    background-clip: text;
    user-select: none;
  }
  #top .mk-newsletter-form .input {
    min-height: 3rem;
  }
  /* light or dark: the Swap writes the page's dark class - every look has a light and a dark palette */
  #top .site-mode {
    flex: none;
    border: 1px solid var(--input);
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    background: var(--background);
    color: var(--foreground);
  }
  #top .site-mode:hover {
    background: var(--accent);
    color: var(--accent-foreground);
  }
  /* -- modes: each look in light and dark, derived from the palettes above (the other mode of each look) -- */
  :root:not(.dark) #top[data-look='daybreak'] {
    --accent: oklch(0.94 0.025 265);
    --accent-foreground: oklch(0.22 0.035 265);
  }
  .dark #top[data-look='daybreak'] {
    --accent: oklch(0.28 0.05 265);
    --accent-foreground: oklch(0.95 0.01 255);
  }
  .dark #top[data-look='midnight'] {
    --accent: oklch(0.24 0.05 250);
  }
  :root:not(.dark) #top[data-look='midnight'] {
    color-scheme: light;
    --background: oklch(0.985 0.025 250);
    --foreground: oklch(0.2 0.012 200);
    --card: oklch(0.997 0.025 250);
    --card-foreground: oklch(0.2 0.012 200);
    --muted: oklch(0.95 0.025 250);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.46 0.03 210);
    --border: oklch(0.9 0.025 250);
    --input: oklch(0.88 0.025 250);
    --primary: oklch(0.58 0.14 170);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.17 0.03 170);
    --secondary: oklch(0.955 0.025 250);
    --secondary-foreground: oklch(0.25 0.012 200);
    --accent: oklch(0.94 0.025 250);
    --accent-foreground: oklch(0.2 0.012 200);
    --popover: oklch(0.997 0.025 250);
    --popover-foreground: oklch(0.2 0.012 200);
    --ring: oklch(0.58 0.14 170);
    --chart-1: oklch(0.58 0.14 170);
    --chart-2: oklch(0.5 0.15 300);
    --lp-from: oklch(0.58 0.14 170);
    --lp-to: oklch(0.53 0.15 300);
    --lp-bubble: oklch(0.58 0.14 170);
    --lp-bubble-ink: oklch(0.989 0.03 250);
    --lp-strike: oklch(0.53 0.15 300);
    --lp-band: oklch(0.973 0.03 250);
    --lp-cta: oklch(0.58 0.14 170);
    --lp-cta-ink: oklch(0.989 0.03 250);
  }
  :root:not(.dark) #top[data-look='sunbeam'] {
    --accent: oklch(0.93 0.045 85);
  }
  .dark #top[data-look='sunbeam'] {
    color-scheme: dark;
    --background: oklch(0.17 0.016 85);
    --foreground: oklch(0.94 0.01 70);
    --card: oklch(0.205 0.006 85);
    --card-foreground: oklch(0.94 0.01 70);
    --muted: oklch(0.24 0.03 85);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.74 0.03 70);
    --border: oklch(0.31 0.01 70);
    --input: oklch(0.33 0.01 70);
    --primary: oklch(0.93 0.01 70);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.17 0.01 70);
    --secondary: oklch(0.25 0.006 85);
    --secondary-foreground: oklch(0.9 0.01 70);
    --accent: oklch(0.26 0.035 85);
    --accent-foreground: oklch(0.94 0.01 70);
    --popover: oklch(0.215 0.006 85);
    --popover-foreground: oklch(0.94 0.01 70);
    --ring: oklch(0.93 0.01 70);
    --chart-1: oklch(0.72 0.17 60);
    --chart-2: oklch(0.93 0.01 70);
    --lp-from: oklch(0.945 0.01 70);
